title: Lewa Safari Marathon — Tusk event page (organisers, scale, conservation impact, air monitoring)
claims: The event is organised by Tusk in partnership with the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy and co-headline sponsored by Safaricom and Huawei; the 2026 edition returned on 27 June 2026 and the 2027 edition will take place on 15 May 2027.
Approximately 1,400 runners take part each year, with more than 25,000 participants in the event's history.

The marathon has raised over USD 9 million over its 25-year history for wildlife conservation and community development in Kenya, including black rhino and Grevy's zebra protection, healthcare, water, infrastructure and education.

A helicopter monitors the course from the air and helps guide animals such as white rhino away from runners; six hospitals and clinics in and around the conservancy are supported each year, and more than 10,000 schoolchildren have benefited through bursaries and school support.
